messages:
maria: Booting az1 heterogeneous GPU cluster now (mix: A100 + H100). Running kernel & driver sanity, NVLink chain checks, and a quick perf baseline. Will run perf-harness + nvlink-bw-check and post results. Ping if you need ssh access to probe nodes.

sam: ack. I'll watch kernel module validations. What's the expected driver/CUDA combo?

maria: target driver >= 535.86, CUDA 12.2, NCCL 2.18.5. Kernel recommended 5.15+. Nodes with mixed GPU types will be tagged 'hetero-az1'.

ryan: standing by for thermal/overheat alarms. If sustained temps >85C during p95 runs, alert me and I'll enable power capping on H100s.

jen: please keep prod routing off these until we hit p95/p99 targets. We want p95 < 120ms for the 1-token latency probe before any traffic.

maria: agreed — isolation policy applied: 'probe' pool only. No prod routing.

mohit: sharing the perf commands we'll run from infra-tools: 

```
perf-harness run --model redwood-2-70b --devices auto --batch 8 --seq 1024 --duration 10m --metrics p50,p95,p99,throughput
```

and NVLink diagnostic: 

```
nvlink-bw-check --nodes node[01-08] --iters 5
```

sam: running kernel check now: 

```
ssh node01 'uname -r; modinfo nvidia | grep version; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv -l 1'
```

infra-bot: node03 passed kernel/driver sanity (driver=535.86, cuda=12.2). node07 failed (driver=532.21).

maria: node07 is in provisioning pool — reimage + bump driver package. tagging @mohit.

mohit: on it. Reimaging node07 to image-2026-02-10, will re-run checks after reboot.

deploy-bot: perf-harness ramp started on nodes node01-04. Expected duration: 10m.

sam: early numbers (first 2m) — throughput approx: A100 ~12.3 tok/sec, H100 ~39 tok/sec. p95 single-token path: H100 ~86ms, A100 ~220ms (seq=1024, batch=8). NVLink shows degraded bandwidth on node05 chain.

ryan: can we confirm NVLink cable seating on node05? I'll dispatch a tech if needed.

maria: reseat scheduled. Rerunning nvlink-bw-check once tech confirms.

infra-bot: nvlink-bw-check node05 result: link2 reporting 45GB/s (expected ~90GB/s).

maria: marking node05 as no-burst, removing from Dedicated burst pool and escalating to hardware team. Create hardware ticket (HW-az1-128).

jen: cost note — hetero fleet increases tail latency which inflates effective cost; estimate ~1.7x cost per token vs homogeneous A100 fleet for latency-sensitive workloads. Recommend keeping hetero nodes in Dedicated/experimental tiers only.

maria: agree. For now probe-only. Handoff: @ryan and @sam to run a full sweep and confirm green. I'll file INFRA-4321 to track remediations (node07 driver, node05 nvlink, final perf artifacts). :thumbsup:

ryan: copy. I'll post perf artifacts (p95/p99 CSVs, flamegraphs, kernel logs) in the az1 onboarding handoff doc when sweep completes.

sam: quick tip — if you see nvlink asymmetry, run `nvidia-smi nvlink --link-status` and check physical port mapping; often a firmware mismatch shows similar numbers.

maria: noted. Thanks all. Will update INFRA-4321 and move cluster from 'probing' -> 'handoff' once @ryan/@sam mark green.

deploy-bot: ramp complete on nodes node01-04. Collected metrics uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/az1/1768887776/ (artifact: perf-harness.tar.gz).
